daily.annotation: Profit cap fired twice; one win (24 000.00) paid more than half the day’s wagers.

/admin/analytics/revenue.sampleSizeNote: Only 48 bets: at this sample size RTP can land anywhere from about 40% to 160% by luck alone.
/admin/analytics/revenue.gapExplanation: GGR is 27 827.50 below what the 1% edge predicts, which is 1.4 standard deviations: normal luck for 48 bets, driven by one 24 000.00 win on 15 Oct.

dataNotes: Logins are recorded from 15 Oct 2026. Visits are also counted from game sessions and bets, which have always been stored.
Multiplayer rounds are recorded from 15 Oct 2026; leaderboard views are recorded from 15 Oct 2026. Players who used these only before tracking began show as non-users.
Plane-skin and sky use also counts players whose equipped plane or sky isn't the default; a player who changed and then switched back before tracking began can't be seen.

Retention bands: Day 1 = the next day; Day 3 = days 2–4; Day 7 = days 6–8; Day 14 = days 12–16; Day 30 = days 27–33 after the first session (UTC). A band is only reported once players have had the whole band to return.
Feature comparisons show observed differences, not causes: players who stay longer also have more chances to try features.

recommendations.title: Many players don't come back
recommendations.why: 6 of 6 active players played only one session.
recommendations.action: Make the first session more rewarding: a starter challenge, a first-day wheel bonus, or a reminder about daily missions.

recommendations.title: Players are winning more than the house edge allows
recommendations.why: Actual RTP is 221,3% against a theoretical 99,0% over 48 bets.
recommendations.action: This can be normal variance at low volume. Watch it as more bets come in before changing the house edge.

checks.description: Every player’s ledger sums to their credit and bonus balances.
No bet was paid more than once.
No payout is above stake × cash-out multiplier.

rules.title: Under 18
rules.summary: You must be 18 or older to play.
rules.details: Accounts of under-18s are blocked until the player's age is verified. Registration rejects a date of birth under 18.

rules.title: Multiple accounts or bonus farming
rules.summary: One account per person; no farming free credits.
rules.details: Running several accounts, or creating accounts to collect free credits, blocks every account involved and removes their bonus credits.

rules.title: Cheating or exploiting bugs
rules.summary: No bots, scripts or bug exploits.
rules.details: Using scripts or bots, or knowingly exploiting a bug, leads to a 7-day block or, after review, a permanent one.

rules.title: Payment fraud
rules.summary: No stolen cards, chargebacks or payment fraud.
rules.details: Payment fraud, chargebacks or a stolen card permanently blocks the account and freezes its purchases.

rules.title: Payment tampering
rules.summary: Altered payment notifications pause the account for review.
rules.details: A payment notification whose amount doesn't match the order blocks the account until an admin has reviewed it.

rules.title: Abusive name or behaviour
rules.summary: Keep usernames and lobby behaviour respectful.
rules.details: First offence: a warning. Second: a 3-day block. After that: a permanent block.

rules.title: Self-exclusion
rules.summary: Take a break for 24 hours, 7 or 30 days.
rules.details: You can pause your own account for 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days. It can't be undone early.

rules.title: Loss limit reached
rules.summary: Your own loss limit pauses play until it resets.
rules.details: When you reach the daily or weekly loss limit you set, betting pauses until the limit resets.
